1module micro_mg1_0

3!---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4! Purpose:
5! MG microphysics
6!
7! Author: Andrew Gettelman, Hugh Morrison.
8! Contributions from: Xiaohong Liu and Steve Ghan
9! December 2005-May 2010
10! Description in: Morrison and Gettelman, 2008. J. Climate (MG2008)
11! Gettelman et al., 2010 J. Geophys. Res. - Atmospheres (G2010)
12! for questions contact Hugh Morrison, Andrew Gettelman
13! e-mail: morrison@ucar.edu, andrew@ucar.edu
14!
15! NOTE: Modified to allow other microphysics packages (e.g. CARMA) to do ice
16! microphysics in cooperation with the MG liquid microphysics. This is
17! controlled by the do_cldice variable.
18!
19! NOTE: If do_cldice is false, then MG microphysics should not update CLDICE
20! or NUMICE; however, it is assumed that the other microphysics scheme will have
21! updated CLDICE and NUMICE. The other microphysics should handle the following
22! processes that would have been done by MG:
23! - Detrainment (liquid and ice)
24! - Homogeneous ice nucleation
25! - Heterogeneous ice nucleation
26! - Bergeron process
27! - Melting of ice
28! - Freezing of cloud drops
29! - Autoconversion (ice -> snow)
30! - Growth/Sublimation of ice
31! - Sedimentation of ice
32!---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
33! modification for sub-columns, HM, (orig 8/11/10)
34! This is done using the logical 'microp_uniform' set to .true. = uniform for subcolumns
35!---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
36
37! Procedures required:
38! 1) An implementation of the gamma function (if not intrinsic).
39! 2) saturation vapor pressure to specific humidity formula
40! 3) svp over water
41! 4) svp over ice
42
43#ifndef HAVE_GAMMA_INTRINSICS
44use shr_spfn_mod, only: gamma => shr_spfn_gamma
45#endif
46
47 use wv_sat_methods, only: &
48 svp_water => wv_sat_svp_water, &
49 svp_ice => wv_sat_svp_ice, &
50 svp_to_qsat => wv_sat_svp_to_qsat
51
52 use phys_control, only: phys_getopts
53
54implicit none
55private
56save
57

59! option being set to false. The code now behaves as if the default liu_in=.true.

61! done outside of this module.

14314204362044846528 qniic(i,1:pver)=0._r8
14324204362044846528 qric(i,1:pver)=0._r8
14334204362044846528 nsic(i,1:pver)=0._r8
14344204362044846528 nric(i,1:pver)=0._r8
1435
14364204362044846528 rainrt(i,1:pver)=0._r8
1437
1438
1439 ! begin new i,k loop, calculate new cldmax after adjustment to cldm above
1440
1441 ! initialize vertically-integrated rain and snow tendencies
1442
144314014541401454 qrtot = 0._r8
1444 nrtot = 0._r8
1445 qstot = 0._r8
1446 nstot = 0._r8
1447
1448 ! initialize precip at surface
1449
1450 prect(i)=0._r8
1451 preci(i)=0._r8
1452
14534204362042043620 do k=top_lev,pver
1454
14554204362042043620 qcvar=relvar(i,k)
14564204362042043620 cons2=gamma(qcvar+2.47_r8)
14574204362042043620 cons3=gamma(qcvar)
14584204362042043620 cons9=gamma(qcvar+2._r8)
14594204362042043620 cons10=gamma(qcvar+1._r8)
14604204362042043620 cons12=gamma(qcvar+1.15_r8)
14614204362042043620 cons15=gamma(qcvar+bc/3._r8)
14624204362084087240 cons18=qcvar**2.47_r8
1463 cons19=qcvar**2
14644204362084087240 cons20=qcvar**1.15_r8
1465
1466 ! set cwml and cwmi to current qc and qi
1467
1468 cwml(i,k)=qc(i,k)
1469 cwmi(i,k)=qi(i,k)
1470
1471 ! initialize precip fallspeeds to zero
1472
1473 ums(k)=0._r8
1474 uns(k)=0._r8
1475 umr(k)=0._r8
1476 unr(k)=0._r8
1477
1478 ! calculate precip fraction based on maximum overlap assumption
1479
1480 ! for sub-columns cldm has already been set to 1 if cloud
1481 ! water or ice is present, so cldmax will be correctly set below
1482 ! and nothing extra needs to be done here
1483
1484 if (k.eq.top_lev) then
148514014541401454 cldmax(i,k)=cldm(i,k)
1486 else
1487 ! if rain or snow mix ratio is smaller than
1488 ! threshold, then set cldmax to cloud fraction at current level
1489
14904064216640642166 if (do_clubb_sgs) then
149100 if (qc(i,k).ge.qsmall.or.qi(i,k).ge.qsmall) then
149200 cldmax(i,k)=cldm(i,k)
1493 else
149400 cldmax(i,k)=cldmax(i,k-1)
1495 end if
1496 else
1497
14984064216677110816 if (qric(i,k-1).ge.qsmall.or.qniic(i,k-1).ge.qsmall) then
14991245399912453999 cldmax(i,k)=max(cldmax(i,k-1),cldm(i,k))
1500 else
15012818816728188167 cldmax(i,k)=cldm(i,k)
1502 end if
1503 endif
1504 end if
1505
1506 ! decrease in number concentration due to sublimation/evap
1507 ! divide by cloud fraction to get in-cloud decrease
1508 ! don't reduce Nc due to bergeron process
1509
15104204362055595771 if (cmei(i,k) < 0._r8 .and. qi(i,k) > qsmall .and. cldm(i,k) > mincld) then
151136752643675264 nsubi(k)=cmei(i,k)/qi(i,k)*ni(i,k)/cldm(i,k)
1512 else
15133836835638368356 nsubi(k)=0._r8
1514 end if
15154204362042043620 nsubc(k)=0._r8
1516
1517
1518 !ccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
1519 !ccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
1520
1521 ! ice nucleation if activated nuclei exist at t<-5C AND rhmini + 5%
1522
15234204362048560639 if (do_cldice .and. dum2i(i,k).gt.0._r8.and.t(i,k).lt.(tmelt - 5._r8).and. &
1524 relhum(i,k)*esl(i,k)/esi(i,k).gt. rhmini+0.05_r8) then
1525
1526 !if NCAI > 0. then set numice = ncai (as before)
1527 !note: this is gridbox averaged
1528
152932556713255671 nnuccd(k)=(dum2i(i,k)-ni(i,k)/icldm(i,k))/deltat*icldm(i,k)
1530 nnuccd(k)=max(nnuccd(k),0._r8)
1531 nimax = dum2i(i,k)*icldm(i,k)
1532
1533 !Calc mass of new particles using new crystal mass...
1534 !also this will be multiplied by mtime as nnuccd is...
1535
1536 mnuccd(k) = nnuccd(k) * mi0
1537
1538 ! add mnuccd to cmei....
1539 cmei(i,k)= cmei(i,k) + mnuccd(k) * mtime
1540
1541 ! limit cmei
1542
154332556713255671 qvi = svp_to_qsat(esi(i,k), p(i,k))
1544 dqsidt = xxls*qvi/(rv*t(i,k)**2)
1545 abi = 1._r8+dqsidt*xxls/cpp
1546 cmei(i,k)=min(cmei(i,k),(q(i,k)-qvi)/abi/deltat)
1547
1548 ! limit for roundoff error
1549 cmei(i,k)=cmei(i,k)*omsm
1550
1551 else
15523878794938787949 nnuccd(k)=0._r8
1553 nimax = 0._r8
1554 mnuccd(k) = 0._r8
1555 end if
1556
1557 !c............................................................................
1558 !ccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
1559 ! obtain in-cloud values of cloud water/ice mixing ratios and number concentrations
1560 ! for microphysical process calculations
1561 ! units are kg/kg for mixing ratio, 1/kg for number conc
1562
1563 ! limit in-cloud values to 0.005 kg/kg
1564
15654204362042043620 qcic(i,k)=min(cwml(i,k)/lcldm(i,k),5.e-3_r8)
1566 qiic(i,k)=min(cwmi(i,k)/icldm(i,k),5.e-3_r8)
1567 ncic(i,k)=max(nc(i,k)/lcldm(i,k),0._r8)
1568 niic(i,k)=max(ni(i,k)/icldm(i,k),0._r8)
1569
1570 if (qc(i,k) - berg(i,k)*deltat.lt.qsmall) then
15713592136135921361 qcic(i,k)=0._r8
1572 ncic(i,k)=0._r8
1573 if (qc(i,k)-berg(i,k)*deltat.lt.0._r8) then
1574959677959677 berg(i,k)=qc(i,k)/deltat*omsm
1575 end if
1576 end if
1577
15784204362084087240 if (do_cldice .and. qi(i,k)+(cmei(i,k)+berg(i,k))*deltat.lt.qsmall) then
15793334044133340441 qiic(i,k)=0._r8
1580 niic(i,k)=0._r8
1581 if (qi(i,k)+(cmei(i,k)+berg(i,k))*deltat.lt.0._r8) then
158222664262266426 cmei(i,k)=(-qi(i,k)/deltat-berg(i,k))*omsm
1583 end if
1584 end if
1585
1586 ! add to cme output
1587
15884204362042043620 cmeout(i,k) = cmeout(i,k)+cmei(i,k)
1589
1590 !ccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
1591 ! droplet activation
1592 ! calculate potential for droplet activation if cloud water is present
1593 ! formulation from Abdul-Razzak and Ghan (2000) and Abdul-Razzak et al. (1998), AR98
1594 ! number tendency (npccnin) is read in from companion routine
1595
1596 ! assume aerosols already activated are equal to number of existing droplets for simplicity
1597 ! multiply by cloud fraction to obtain grid-average tendency
1598
1599 if (qcic(i,k).ge.qsmall) then
160061222596122259 npccn(k) = max(0._r8,npccnin(i,k))
1601 dum2l(i,k)=(nc(i,k)+npccn(k)*deltat)/lcldm(i,k)
1602 dum2l(i,k)=max(dum2l(i,k),cdnl/rho(i,k)) ! sghan minimum in #/cm3
1603 ncmax = dum2l(i,k)*lcldm(i,k)
1604 else
16053592136135921361 npccn(k)=0._r8
1606 dum2l(i,k)=0._r8
1607 ncmax = 0._r8
1608 end if
1609
1610 !ccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
1611 ! get size distribution parameters based on in-cloud cloud water/ice
1612 ! these calculations also ensure consistency between number and mixing ratio
1613 !cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
1614
1615 !......................................................................
1616 ! cloud ice
1617
16184204362042043620 if (qiic(i,k).ge.qsmall) then
1619
1620 ! add upper limit to in-cloud number concentration to prevent numerical error
162186543958654395 niic(i,k)=min(niic(i,k),qiic(i,k)*1.e20_r8)
1622
1623865439517308790 lami(k) = (cons1*ci*niic(i,k)/qiic(i,k))**(1._r8/di)
1624 n0i(k) = niic(i,k)*lami(k)
1625
1626 ! check for slope
1627 ! adjust vars
1628
1629 if (lami(k).lt.lammini) then
1630
1631213751213751 lami(k) = lammini
1632213751427502 n0i(k) = lami(k)**(di+1._r8)*qiic(i,k)/(ci*cons1)
1633 niic(i,k) = n0i(k)/lami(k)
163484406448440644 else if (lami(k).gt.lammaxi) then
1635400649400649 lami(k) = lammaxi
1636400649801298 n0i(k) = lami(k)**(di+1._r8)*qiic(i,k)/(ci*cons1)
1637 niic(i,k) = n0i(k)/lami(k)
1638 end if
1639
1640 else
16413338922533389225 lami(k) = 0._r8
1642 n0i(k) = 0._r8
1643 end if
1644
16454204362042043620 if (qcic(i,k).ge.qsmall) then
1646
1647 ! add upper limit to in-cloud number concentration to prevent numerical error
164861222596122259 ncic(i,k)=min(ncic(i,k),qcic(i,k)*1.e20_r8)
1649
1650 ncic(i,k)=max(ncic(i,k),cdnl/rho(i,k)) ! sghan minimum in #/cm
1651
1652 ! get pgam from fit to observations of martin et al. 1994
1653
1654 pgam(k)=0.0005714_r8*(ncic(i,k)/1.e6_r8*rho(i,k))+0.2714_r8
1655 pgam(k)=1._r8/(pgam(k)**2)-1._r8
1656 pgam(k)=max(pgam(k),2._r8)
1657 pgam(k)=min(pgam(k),15._r8)
1658
1659 ! calculate lamc
1660
1661612225918366777 lamc(k) = (pi/6._r8*rhow*ncic(i,k)*gamma(pgam(k)+4._r8)/ &
166261222596122259 (qcic(i,k)*gamma(pgam(k)+1._r8)))**(1._r8/3._r8)
1663
1664 ! lammin, 50 micron diameter max mean size
1665
1666 lammin = (pgam(k)+1._r8)/50.e-6_r8
1667 lammax = (pgam(k)+1._r8)/2.e-6_r8
1668
1669 if (lamc(k).lt.lammin) then
167014743931474393 lamc(k) = lammin
167114743932948786 ncic(i,k) = 6._r8*lamc(k)**3*qcic(i,k)* &
167214743931474393 gamma(pgam(k)+1._r8)/(pi*rhow*gamma(pgam(k)+4._r8))
167346478664647866 else if (lamc(k).gt.lammax) then
1674361256361256 lamc(k) = lammax
1675361256722512 ncic(i,k) = 6._r8*lamc(k)**3*qcic(i,k)* &
1676361256361256 gamma(pgam(k)+1._r8)/(pi*rhow*gamma(pgam(k)+4._r8))
1677 end if
1678
1679 ! parameter to calculate droplet freezing
1680
168161222596122259 cdist1(k) = ncic(i,k)/gamma(pgam(k)+1._r8)
1682
1683 else
16843592136135921361 lamc(k) = 0._r8
1685 cdist1(k) = 0._r8
1686 end if
1687
1688 !cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
1689 !cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
1690 ! begin micropysical process calculations
1691 !.................................................................
1692 ! autoconversion of cloud liquid water to rain
1693 ! formula from Khrouditnov and Kogan (2000), modified for sub-grid distribution of qc
1694 ! minimum qc of 1 x 10^-8 prevents floating point error
1695
16964204362042043620 if (qcic(i,k).ge.1.e-8_r8) then
1697
1698 ! nprc is increase in rain number conc due to autoconversion
1699 ! nprc1 is decrease in cloud droplet conc due to autoconversion
1700
1701 ! assume exponential sub-grid distribution of qc, resulting in additional
1702 ! factor related to qcvar below
1703
1704 ! hm switch for sub-columns, don't include sub-grid qc
170554532515453251 if (microp_uniform) then
1706
170700 prc(k) = 1350._r8*qcic(i,k)**2.47_r8* &
1708 (ncic(i,k)/1.e6_r8*rho(i,k))**(-1.79_r8)
170900 nprc(k) = prc(k)/(4._r8/3._r8*pi*rhow*(25.e-6_r8)**3)
1710 nprc1(k) = prc(k)/(qcic(i,k)/ncic(i,k))
1711
1712 else
1713
1714545325116359753 prc(k) = cons2/(cons3*cons18)*1350._r8*qcic(i,k)**2.47_r8* &
1715 (ncic(i,k)/1.e6_r8*rho(i,k))**(-1.79_r8)
1716 nprc(k) = prc(k)/cons22
1717 nprc1(k) = prc(k)/(qcic(i,k)/ncic(i,k))
1718
1719 end if ! sub-column switch
1720
1721 else
17223659036936590369 prc(k)=0._r8
1723 nprc(k)=0._r8
1724 nprc1(k)=0._r8
1725 end if
1726
1727 ! add autoconversion to precip from above to get provisional rain mixing ratio
1728 ! and number concentration (qric and nric)
1729
1730 ! 0.45 m/s is fallspeed of new rain drop (80 micron diameter)
1731
17324204362042043620 dum=0.45_r8
1733 dum1=0.45_r8
1734
1735 if (k.eq.top_lev) then
173614014541401454 qric(i,k)=prc(k)*lcldm(i,k)*dz(i,k)/cldmax(i,k)/dum
1737 nric(i,k)=nprc(k)*lcldm(i,k)*dz(i,k)/cldmax(i,k)/dum
1738 else
17394064216640642166 if (qric(i,k-1).ge.qsmall) then
174041735164173516 dum=umr(k-1)
1741 dum1=unr(k-1)
1742 end if
1743
1744 ! no autoconversion of rain number if rain/snow falling from above
1745 ! this assumes that new drizzle drops formed by autoconversion are rapidly collected
1746 ! by the existing rain/snow particles from above
1747
17484064216677403152 if (qric(i,k-1).ge.1.e-9_r8.or.qniic(i,k-1).ge.1.e-9_r8) then
17491025921810259218 nprc(k)=0._r8
1750 end if
1751
17524064216640642166 qric(i,k) = (rho(i,k-1)*umr(k-1)*qric(i,k-1)*cldmax(i,k-1)+ &
1753 (rho(i,k)*dz(i,k)*((pra(k-1)+prc(k))*lcldm(i,k)+(pre(k-1)-pracs(k-1)-mnuccr(k-1))*cldmax(i,k))))&
1754 /(dum*rho(i,k)*cldmax(i,k))
1755 nric(i,k) = (rho(i,k-1)*unr(k-1)*nric(i,k-1)*cldmax(i,k-1)+ &
1756 (rho(i,k)*dz(i,k)*(nprc(k)*lcldm(i,k)+(nsubr(k-1)-npracs(k-1)-nnuccr(k-1)+nragg(k-1))*cldmax(i,k))))&
1757 /(dum1*rho(i,k)*cldmax(i,k))
1758
1759 end if
1760
1761 !.......................................................................
1762 ! Autoconversion of cloud ice to snow
1763 ! similar to Ferrier (1994)
1764
17654204362042043620 if (do_cldice) then
17664204362073661709 if (t(i,k).le.273.15_r8.and.qiic(i,k).ge.qsmall) then
1767
1768 ! note: assumes autoconversion timescale of 180 sec
1769
177079092387909238 nprci(k) = n0i(k)/(lami(k)*180._r8)*exp(-lami(k)*dcs)
1771
177279092387909238 prci(k) = pi*rhoi*n0i(k)/(6._r8*180._r8)* &
177379092387909238 (cons23/lami(k)+3._r8*cons24/lami(k)**2+ &
177479092387909238 6._r8*dcs/lami(k)**3+6._r8/lami(k)**4)*exp(-lami(k)*dcs)
1775 else
17763413438234134382 prci(k)=0._r8
1777 nprci(k)=0._r8
1778 end if
1779 else
1780 ! Add in the particles that we have already converted to snow, and
1781 ! don't do any further autoconversion of ice.
178200 prci(k) = tnd_qsnow(i, k) / cldm(i,k)
1783 nprci(k) = tnd_nsnow(i, k) / cldm(i,k)
1784 end if
1785
1786 ! add autoconversion to flux from level above to get provisional snow mixing ratio
1787 ! and number concentration (qniic and nsic)
1788
17894204362042043620 dum=(asn(i,k)*cons25)
1790 dum1=(asn(i,k)*cons25)
1791
1792 if (k.eq.top_lev) then
179314014541401454 qniic(i,k)=prci(k)*icldm(i,k)*dz(i,k)/cldmax(i,k)/dum
1794 nsic(i,k)=nprci(k)*icldm(i,k)*dz(i,k)/cldmax(i,k)/dum
1795 else
17964064216640642166 if (qniic(i,k-1).ge.qsmall) then
179787630778763077 dum=ums(k-1)
1798 dum1=uns(k-1)
1799 end if
1800
18014064216640642166 qniic(i,k) = (rho(i,k-1)*ums(k-1)*qniic(i,k-1)*cldmax(i,k-1)+ &
1802 (rho(i,k)*dz(i,k)*((prci(k)+prai(k-1)+psacws(k-1)+bergs(k-1))*icldm(i,k)+(prds(k-1)+ &
1803 pracs(k-1)+mnuccr(k-1))*cldmax(i,k))))&
1804 /(dum*rho(i,k)*cldmax(i,k))
1805
1806 nsic(i,k) = (rho(i,k-1)*uns(k-1)*nsic(i,k-1)*cldmax(i,k-1)+ &
1807 (rho(i,k)*dz(i,k)*(nprci(k)*icldm(i,k)+(nsubs(k-1)+nsagg(k-1)+nnuccr(k-1))*cldmax(i,k))))&
1808 /(dum1*rho(i,k)*cldmax(i,k))
1809
1810 end if
1811
1812 ! if precip mix ratio is zero so should number concentration
1813
18144204362042043620 if (qniic(i,k).lt.qsmall) then
18153247242432472424 qniic(i,k)=0._r8
1816 nsic(i,k)=0._r8
1817 end if
1818
18194204362042043620 if (qric(i,k).lt.qsmall) then
18203585039135850391 qric(i,k)=0._r8
1821 nric(i,k)=0._r8
1822 end if
1823
1824 ! make sure number concentration is a positive number to avoid
1825 ! taking root of negative later
1826
18274204362042043620 nric(i,k)=max(nric(i,k),0._r8)
1828 nsic(i,k)=max(nsic(i,k),0._r8)
1829
1830 !.......................................................................
1831 ! get size distribution parameters for precip
1832 !......................................................................
1833 ! rain
1834
1835 if (qric(i,k).ge.qsmall) then
1836619322912386458 lamr(k) = (pi*rhow*nric(i,k)/qric(i,k))**(1._r8/3._r8)
1837 n0r(k) = nric(i,k)*lamr(k)
1838
1839 ! check for slope
1840 ! adjust vars
1841
1842 if (lamr(k).lt.lamminr) then
1843
184419614531961453 lamr(k) = lamminr
1845
184619614531961453 n0r(k) = lamr(k)**4*qric(i,k)/(pi*rhow)
1847 nric(i,k) = n0r(k)/lamr(k)
184842317764231776 else if (lamr(k).gt.lammaxr) then
18493825238252 lamr(k) = lammaxr
18503825238252 n0r(k) = lamr(k)**4*qric(i,k)/(pi*rhow)
1851 nric(i,k) = n0r(k)/lamr(k)
1852 end if
1853
1854 ! provisional rain number and mass weighted mean fallspeed (m/s)
1855
1856619322912386458 unr(k) = min(arn(i,k)*cons4/lamr(k)**br,9.1_r8*rhof(i,k))
1857619322912386458 umr(k) = min(arn(i,k)*cons5/(6._r8*lamr(k)**br),9.1_r8*rhof(i,k))
1858
1859 else
18603585039135850391 lamr(k) = 0._r8
1861 n0r(k) = 0._r8
1862 umr(k) = 0._r8
1863 unr(k) = 0._r8
1864 end if
1865
1866 !......................................................................
1867 ! snow
1868
18694204362042043620 if (qniic(i,k).ge.qsmall) then
1870957119619142392 lams(k) = (cons6*cs*nsic(i,k)/qniic(i,k))**(1._r8/ds)
1871 n0s(k) = nsic(i,k)*lams(k)
1872
1873 ! check for slope
1874 ! adjust vars
1875
1876 if (lams(k).lt.lammins) then
1877165965165965 lams(k) = lammins
1878165965331930 n0s(k) = lams(k)**(ds+1._r8)*qniic(i,k)/(cs*cons6)
1879 nsic(i,k) = n0s(k)/lams(k)
1880
188194052319405231 else if (lams(k).gt.lammaxs) then
18822910429104 lams(k) = lammaxs
18832910458208 n0s(k) = lams(k)**(ds+1._r8)*qniic(i,k)/(cs*cons6)
1884 nsic(i,k) = n0s(k)/lams(k)
1885 end if
1886
1887 ! provisional snow number and mass weighted mean fallspeed (m/s)
1888
1889957119619142392 ums(k) = min(asn(i,k)*cons8/(6._r8*lams(k)**bs),1.2_r8*rhof(i,k))
1890957119619142392 uns(k) = min(asn(i,k)*cons7/lams(k)**bs,1.2_r8*rhof(i,k))
1891
1892 else
18933247242432472424 lams(k) = 0._r8
1894 n0s(k) = 0._r8
1895 ums(k) = 0._r8
1896 uns(k) = 0._r8
1897 end if
1898
1899 !cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
1900
1901 ! heterogeneous freezing of cloud water
1902

3042 !ccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
3043 ! calculate sedimentation for cloud water and ice
3044 !ccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
3045
3046 ! update in-cloud cloud mixing ratio and number concentration
3047 ! with microphysical tendencies to calculate sedimentation, assign to dummy vars
3048 ! note: these are in-cloud values***, hence we divide by cloud fraction
3049
3050 dumc(i,k) = (qc(i,k)+qctend(i,k)*deltat)/lcldm(i,k)
3051 dumi(i,k) = (qi(i,k)+qitend(i,k)*deltat)/icldm(i,k)
3052 dumnc(i,k) = max((nc(i,k)+nctend(i,k)*deltat)/lcldm(i,k),0._r8)
3053 dumni(i,k) = max((ni(i,k)+nitend(i,k)*deltat)/icldm(i,k),0._r8)
3054
3055 ! obtain new slope parameter to avoid possible singularity
3056
3057 if (dumi(i,k).ge.qsmall) then
3058 ! add upper limit to in-cloud number concentration to prevent numerical error
305954803005480300 dumni(i,k)=min(dumni(i,k),dumi(i,k)*1.e20_r8)
3060
3061548030010960600 lami(k) = (cons1*ci* &
3062 dumni(i,k)/dumi(i,k))**(1._r8/di)
3063 lami(k)=max(lami(k),lammini)
3064 lami(k)=min(lami(k),lammaxi)
3065 else
30661554151015541510 lami(k)=0._r8
3067 end if
3068
30692102181021021810 if (dumc(i,k).ge.qsmall) then
3070 ! add upper limit to in-cloud number concentration to prevent numerical error
307138825453882545 dumnc(i,k)=min(dumnc(i,k),dumc(i,k)*1.e20_r8)
3072 ! add lower limit to in-cloud number concentration
3073 dumnc(i,k)=max(dumnc(i,k),cdnl/rho(i,k)) ! sghan minimum in #/cm3
3074 pgam(k)=0.0005714_r8*(ncic(i,k)/1.e6_r8*rho(i,k))+0.2714_r8
3075 pgam(k)=1._r8/(pgam(k)**2)-1._r8
3076 pgam(k)=max(pgam(k),2._r8)
3077 pgam(k)=min(pgam(k),15._r8)
3078
3079388254511647635 lamc(k) = (pi/6._r8*rhow*dumnc(i,k)*gamma(pgam(k)+4._r8)/ &
308038825453882545 (dumc(i,k)*gamma(pgam(k)+1._r8)))**(1._r8/3._r8)
3081 lammin = (pgam(k)+1._r8)/50.e-6_r8
3082 lammax = (pgam(k)+1._r8)/2.e-6_r8
3083 lamc(k)=max(lamc(k),lammin)
3084 lamc(k)=min(lamc(k),lammax)
3085 else
30861713926517139265 lamc(k)=0._r8
3087 end if

3091
3092
30932102181021021810 if (dumc(i,k).ge.qsmall) then
3094388254511647635 unc = acn(i,k)*gamma(1._r8+bc+pgam(k))/(lamc(k)**bc*gamma(pgam(k)+1._r8))
3095388254511647635 umc = acn(i,k)*gamma(4._r8+bc+pgam(k))/(lamc(k)**bc*gamma(pgam(k)+4._r8))
3096 ! fallspeed for output
3097 vtrmc(i,k)=umc
3098 else
30991713926517139265 umc = 0._r8
3100 unc = 0._r8
3101 end if
3102
3103 ! calculate number and mass weighted fall velocity for cloud ice
3104
31052102181021021810 if (dumi(i,k).ge.qsmall) then
3106548030010960600 uni = ain(i,k)*cons16/lami(k)**bi
3107548030010960600 umi = ain(i,k)*cons17/(6._r8*lami(k)**bi)
3108 uni=min(uni,1.2_r8*rhof(i,k))
3109 umi=min(umi,1.2_r8*rhof(i,k))
3110

3113 else

31411750584017505840 if (dumc(i,k).lt.qsmall) dumnc(i,k)=0._r8

31845640105656401056 do k = top_lev+1,pver
3185
3186 ! for cloud liquid and ice, if cloud fraction increases with height

3194 dum1=min(dum1,1._r8)
3195
3196 faltndqie=(falouti(k)-falouti(k-1))/pdel(i,k)
3197 faltndi=(falouti(k)-dum1*falouti(k-1))/pdel(i,k)
3198 faltndni=(faloutni(k)-dum1*faloutni(k-1))/pdel(i,k)
3199 faltndqce=(faloutc(k)-faloutc(k-1))/pdel(i,k)
3200 faltndc=(faloutc(k)-dum*faloutc(k-1))/pdel(i,k)
3201 faltndnc=(faloutnc(k)-dum*faloutnc(k-1))/pdel(i,k)
3202
3203 ! add fallout terms to eulerian tendencies
3204
3205 qitend(i,k) = qitend(i,k)-faltndi/nstep
3206 nitend(i,k) = nitend(i,k)-faltndni/nstep
3207 qctend(i,k) = qctend(i,k)-faltndc/nstep
3208 nctend(i,k) = nctend(i,k)-faltndnc/nstep
3209
3210 ! sedimentation tendencies for output
3211 qcsedten(i,k)=qcsedten(i,k)-faltndc/nstep
3212 qisedten(i,k)=qisedten(i,k)-faltndi/nstep
3213
3214 ! add terms to to evap/sub of cloud water
3215
3216 qvlat(i,k)=qvlat(i,k)-(faltndqie-faltndi)/nstep
3217 ! for output
3218 qisevap(i,k)=qisevap(i,k)-(faltndqie-faltndi)/nstep
3219 qvlat(i,k)=qvlat(i,k)-(faltndqce-faltndc)/nstep
3220 ! for output
3221 qcsevap(i,k)=qcsevap(i,k)-(faltndqce-faltndc)/nstep
3222
3223 tlat(i,k)=tlat(i,k)+(faltndqie-faltndi)*xxls/nstep
3224 tlat(i,k)=tlat(i,k)+(faltndqce-faltndc)*xxlv/nstep
3225
3226 dumi(i,k) = dumi(i,k)-faltndi*deltat/nstep
3227 dumni(i,k) = dumni(i,k)-faltndni*deltat/nstep
3228 dumc(i,k) = dumc(i,k)-faltndc*deltat/nstep
3229 dumnc(i,k) = dumnc(i,k)-faltndnc*deltat/nstep
3230
3231 Fni(K)=MAX(Fni(K)/pdel(i,K),Fni(K-1)/pdel(i,K-1))*pdel(i,K)
3232 FI(K)=MAX(FI(K)/pdel(i,K),FI(K-1)/pdel(i,K-1))*pdel(i,K)
3233 fnc(k)=max(fnc(k)/pdel(i,k),fnc(k-1)/pdel(i,k-1))*pdel(i,k)
3234 Fc(K)=MAX(Fc(K)/pdel(i,K),Fc(K-1)/pdel(i,K-1))*pdel(i,K)
3235
3236 end do !! k loop
3237
3238 ! units below are m/s
3239 ! cloud water/ice sedimentation flux at surface
3240 ! is added to precip flux at surface to get total precip (cloud + precip water)
3241 ! rate
3242
3243 prect(i) = prect(i)+(faloutc(pver)+falouti(pver))/g/nstep/1000._r8
3244 preci(i) = preci(i)+(falouti(pver))/g/nstep/1000._r8
3245
3246 end do !! nstep loop
3247
3248 ! end sedimentation

3250

3253
32542102181021722537 do k=top_lev,pver
3255
32562102181021021810 dumc(i,k) = max(qc(i,k)+qctend(i,k)*deltat,0._r8)
3257 dumi(i,k) = max(qi(i,k)+qitend(i,k)*deltat,0._r8)

3260
32611679768816797688 if (dumc(i,k).lt.qsmall) dumnc(i,k)=0._r8
32622102181036007003 if (dumi(i,k).lt.qsmall) dumni(i,k)=0._r8
3263

32652102181021021810 if (do_cldice) then
3266
32672102181021021810 if (t(i,k)+tlat(i,k)/cpp*deltat > tmelt) then
326852099005209900 if (dumi(i,k) > 0._r8) then

3277 else
327811047711104771 dum = 1._r8
3279 end if

328111047751104775 qctend(i,k)=qctend(i,k)+dum*dumi(i,k)/deltat

3290 (4._r8*pi*5.12e-16_r8*rhow)
3291

3297 end if

33022102181021021810 if (t(i,k)+tlat(i,k)/cpp*deltat < 233.15_r8) then
33031005368010053680 if (dumc(i,k) > 0._r8) then
3304

330613850821385082 dum = dumc(i,k)*xlf/cpp

330800 dum = -(t(i,k)+tlat(i,k)/cpp*deltat-233.15_r8)*cpp/xlf
3309 dum = dum/dumc(i,k)*xlf/cpp

331313850821385082 dum = 1._r8
3314 end if

3325 nctend(i,k)=((1._r8-dum)*dumnc(i,k)-nc(i,k))/deltat

33402102181021021810 qsn = svp_to_qsat(esn, p(i,k))
3341
33427020970209 if (qtmp > qsn .and. qsn > 0) then

3345 ! add to output cme

335162456245 else if (ttmp < 238.15_r8) then
3352181181 dum1=1.0_r8
3353 else
335460646064 dum1=(268.15_r8-ttmp)/30._r8

3370 end if
3371 end if

3380
33812102181021021810 dumc(i,k) = max(qc(i,k)+qctend(i,k)*deltat,0._r8)/lcldm(i,k)
3382 dumi(i,k) = max(qi(i,k)+qitend(i,k)*deltat,0._r8)/icldm(i,k)
3383 dumnc(i,k) = max(nc(i,k)+nctend(i,k)*deltat,0._r8)/lcldm(i,k)
3384 dumni(i,k) = max(ni(i,k)+nitend(i,k)*deltat,0._r8)/icldm(i,k)
3385

3387
3388 dumc(i,k)=min(dumc(i,k),5.e-3_r8)
3389 dumi(i,k)=min(dumi(i,k),5.e-3_r8)
3390
3391 !...................
3392 ! cloud ice effective radius
3393
3394 if (dumi(i,k).ge.qsmall) then
3395 ! add upper limit to in-cloud number concentration to prevent numerical error
339657305765730576 dumni(i,k)=min(dumni(i,k),dumi(i,k)*1.e20_r8)
3397573057611461152 lami(k) = (cons1*ci*dumni(i,k)/dumi(i,k))**(1._r8/di)
3398
3399 if (lami(k).lt.lammini) then
34001627616276 lami(k) = lammini
34011627632552 n0i(k) = lami(k)**(di+1._r8)*dumi(i,k)/(ci*cons1)

34041627616276 if (do_cldice) nitend(i,k)=(niic(i,k)*icldm(i,k)-ni(i,k))/deltat
3405
340657143005714300 else if (lami(k).gt.lammaxi) then
340719520631952063 lami(k) = lammaxi
340819520633904126 n0i(k) = lami(k)**(di+1._r8)*dumi(i,k)/(ci*cons1)
3409 niic(i,k) = n0i(k)/lami(k)
3410 ! adjust number conc if needed to keep mean size in reasonable range
341119520631952063 if (do_cldice) nitend(i,k)=(niic(i,k)*icldm(i,k)-ni(i,k))/deltat
3412 end if
341357305765730576 effi(i,k) = 1.5_r8/lami(k)*1.e6_r8
3414
3415 else
34161529123415291234 effi(i,k) = 25._r8
3417 end if

3423 end if

3427
34282102181021021810 if (dumc(i,k).ge.qsmall) then
3429
3430 ! add upper limit to in-cloud number concentration to prevent numerical error
343146580124658012 dumnc(i,k)=min(dumnc(i,k),dumc(i,k)*1.e20_r8)
3432

3437 if (dumnc(i,k).lt.cdnl/rho(i,k)) then

344046580124658012 dumnc(i,k)=max(dumnc(i,k),cdnl/rho(i,k)) ! sghan minimum in #/cm3
3441!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
3442 pgam(k)=0.0005714_r8*(ncic(i,k)/1.e6_r8*rho(i,k))+0.2714_r8
3443 pgam(k)=1._r8/(pgam(k)**2)-1._r8
3444 pgam(k)=max(pgam(k),2._r8)
3445 pgam(k)=min(pgam(k),15._r8)
3446
3447465801213974036 lamc(k) = (pi/6._r8*rhow*dumnc(i,k)*gamma(pgam(k)+4._r8)/ &
344846580124658012 (dumc(i,k)*gamma(pgam(k)+1._r8)))**(1._r8/3._r8)
3449 lammin = (pgam(k)+1._r8)/50.e-6_r8

3452 if (lamc(k).lt.lammin) then
3453213577213577 lamc(k) = lammin
3454213577427154 ncic(i,k) = 6._r8*lamc(k)**3*dumc(i,k)* &
3455213577213577 gamma(pgam(k)+1._r8)/ &
3456 (pi*rhow*gamma(pgam(k)+4._r8))
3457 ! adjust number conc if needed to keep mean size in reasonable range
3458 nctend(i,k)=(ncic(i,k)*lcldm(i,k)-nc(i,k))/deltat
3459
346044444354444435 else if (lamc(k).gt.lammax) then
346113242071324207 lamc(k) = lammax
346213242072648414 ncic(i,k) = 6._r8*lamc(k)**3*dumc(i,k)* &
346313242071324207 gamma(pgam(k)+1._r8)/ &
3464 (pi*rhow*gamma(pgam(k)+4._r8))
3465 ! adjust number conc if needed to keep mean size in reasonable range
3466 nctend(i,k)=(ncic(i,k)*lcldm(i,k)-nc(i,k))/deltat
3467 end if
3468
346946580124658012 effc(i,k) = &
347046580124658012 gamma(pgam(k)+4._r8)/ &
3471 gamma(pgam(k)+3._r8)/lamc(k)/2._r8*1.e6_r8
3472 !assign output fields for shape here

3474 pgamrad(i,k)=pgam(k)
3475
3476 else

3478 lamcrad(i,k)=0._r8
3479 pgamrad(i,k)=0._r8
3480 end if

3485 else

349746580124658012 pgam(k)=0.0005714_r8*(ncic(i,k)/1.e6_r8*rho(i,k))+0.2714_r8
3498 pgam(k)=1._r8/(pgam(k)**2)-1._r8
3499 pgam(k)=max(pgam(k),2._r8)
3500 pgam(k)=min(pgam(k),15._r8)
3501
3502465801213974036 lamc(k) = (pi/6._r8*rhow*dumnc(i,k)*gamma(pgam(k)+4._r8)/ &
350346580124658012 (dumc(i,k)*gamma(pgam(k)+1._r8)))**(1._r8/3._r8)
3504 lammin = (pgam(k)+1._r8)/50.e-6_r8
3505 lammax = (pgam(k)+1._r8)/2.e-6_r8
3506 if (lamc(k).lt.lammin) then
350700 lamc(k) = lammin
350846580124658012 else if (lamc(k).gt.lammax) then
3509 lamc(k) = lammax
3510 end if
351146580124658012 effc_fn(i,k) = &
351246580124658012 gamma(pgam(k)+4._r8)/ &
3513 gamma(pgam(k)+3._r8)/lamc(k)/2._r8*1.e6_r8
3514
3515 else
35161636379816363798 effc_fn(i,k) = 10._r8
3517 end if
3518

3520!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!1!

3522 end do ! vertical k loop
3523
3524500 continue
3525
35262102181021722537 do k=top_lev,pver

3531 end do
3532
3533end do ! i loop

3536700727753975do i = 1,ncol

35382102181023492408 if (qsout(i,k).gt.1.e-7_r8.and.nsout(i,k).gt.0._r8) then
353924705984941196 dsout(i,k)=3._r8*rhosn/917._r8*(pi * rhosn * nsout(i,k)/qsout(i,k))**(-1._r8/3._r8)
3540 endif

3542end do

3544!calculate effective radius of rain and snow in microns for COSP using Eq. 9 of COSP v1.3 manual
3545700727753975do i = 1,ncol

3547 !! RAIN
35482102181022727253 if (qrout(i,k).gt.1.e-7_r8.and.nrout(i,k).gt.0._r8) then
354917054433410886 reff_rain(i,k)=1.5_r8*(pi * rhow * nrout(i,k)/qrout(i,k))**(-1._r8/3._r8)*1.e6_r8
3550 endif

3554 end if
3555 end do
3556end do

3558! analytic radar reflectivity
3559! formulas from Matthew Shupe, NOAA/CERES
3560! *****note: radar reflectivity is local (in-precip average)
3561! units of mm^6/m^3
3562
3563700727753975do i = 1,ncol
35642102181021722537 do k=top_lev,pver
35652102181021021810 if (qc(i,k)+qctend(i,k)*deltat.ge.qsmall) then
356643741494374149 dum=((qc(i,k)+qctend(i,k)*deltat)/lcldm(i,k)*rho(i,k)*1000._r8)**2 &
3567 /(0.109_r8*(nc(i,k)+nctend(i,k)*deltat)/lcldm(i,k)*rho(i,k)/1.e6_r8)*lcldm(i,k)/cldmax(i,k)
3568 else
35691664766116647661 dum=0._r8
3570 end if
35712102181021021810 if (qi(i,k)+qitend(i,k)*deltat.ge.qsmall) then
3572535237210704744 dum1=((qi(i,k)+qitend(i,k)*deltat)*rho(i,k)/icldm(i,k)*1000._r8/0.1_r8)**(1._r8/0.63_r8)*icldm(i,k)/cldmax(i,k)
3573 else
35741566943815669438 dum1=0._r8
3575 end if
3576
35772102181021021810 if (qsout(i,k).ge.qsmall) then
3578514171410283428 dum1=dum1+(qsout(i,k)*rho(i,k)*1000._r8/0.1_r8)**(1._r8/0.63_r8)
3579 end if
3580
35812102181021021810 refl(i,k)=dum+dum1
3582
3583 ! add rain rate, but for 37 GHz formulation instead of 94 GHz
3584 ! formula approximated from data of Matrasov (2007)
3585 ! rainrt is the rain rate in mm/hr
3586 ! reflectivity (dum) is in DBz
3587
3588 if (rainrt(i,k).ge.0.001_r8) then
358922735086820524 dum=log10(rainrt(i,k)**6._r8)+16._r8
3590
3591 ! convert from DBz to mm^6/m^3
3592
359322735084547016 dum = 10._r8**(dum/10._r8)
3594 else
3595 ! don't include rain rate in R calculation for values less than 0.001 mm/hr
35961874830218748302 dum=0._r8
3597 end if
3598
3599 ! add to refl
3600
36012102181021021810 refl(i,k)=refl(i,k)+dum
3602
3603 !output reflectivity in Z.
3604 areflz(i,k)=refl(i,k)
3605
3606 ! convert back to DBz
3607
3608 if (refl(i,k).gt.minrefl) then
3609786797715735954 refl(i,k)=10._r8*log10(refl(i,k))
3610 else
36111315383313153833 refl(i,k)=-9999._r8
3612 end if
3613
3614 !set averaging flag
36152102181021021810 if (refl(i,k).gt.mindbz) then
361678679777867977 arefl(i,k)=refl(i,k)
3617 frefl(i,k)=1.0_r8
3618 else
36191315383313153833 arefl(i,k)=0._r8
3620 areflz(i,k)=0._r8
3621 frefl(i,k)=0._r8
3622 end if
3623
3624 ! bound cloudsat reflectivity
3625
36262102181021021810 csrfl(i,k)=min(csmax,refl(i,k))
3627
3628 !set averaging flag
3629 if (csrfl(i,k).gt.csmin) then
363046635594663559 acsrfl(i,k)=refl(i,k)
3631 fcsrfl(i,k)=1.0_r8
3632 else
36331635825116358251 acsrfl(i,k)=0._r8
3634 fcsrfl(i,k)=0._r8
3635 end if
3636
3637 end do
3638end do
3639
3640
3641! averaging for snow and rain number and diameter
3642
36432102181025920626qrout2(:,:)=0._r8
36442102181025920626qsout2(:,:)=0._r8
36452102181025920626nrout2(:,:)=0._r8
36462102181025920626nsout2(:,:)=0._r8
36472102181025920626drout2(:,:)=0._r8
36482102181025920626dsout2(:,:)=0._r8
36492102181025920626freqs(:,:)=0._r8
36502102181025920626freqr(:,:)=0._r8
3651700727753975do i = 1,ncol
36522102181021722537 do k=top_lev,pver
36532102181022727253 if (qrout(i,k).gt.1.e-7_r8.and.nrout(i,k).gt.0._r8) then
365417054431705443 qrout2(i,k)=qrout(i,k)
3655 nrout2(i,k)=nrout(i,k)
365617054433410886 drout2(i,k)=(pi * rhow * nrout(i,k)/qrout(i,k))**(-1._r8/3._r8)
3657 freqr(i,k)=1._r8
3658 endif
36592102181023492408 if (qsout(i,k).gt.1.e-7_r8.and.nsout(i,k).gt.0._r8) then
366024705982470598 qsout2(i,k)=qsout(i,k)
3661 nsout2(i,k)=nsout(i,k)
366224705984941196 dsout2(i,k)=(pi * rhosn * nsout(i,k)/qsout(i,k))**(-1._r8/3._r8)
3663 freqs(i,k)=1._r8
3664 endif
3665 end do
3666end do
3667
3668! output activated liquid and ice (convert from #/kg -> #/m3)
3669700727753975do i = 1,ncol
36702102181021722537 do k=top_lev,pver
3671 ncai(i,k)=dum2i(i,k)*rho(i,k)
3672 ncal(i,k)=dum2l(i,k)*rho(i,k)
3673 end do
3674end do
3675
3676
3677!redefine fice here....
36782102181025920626nfice(:,:)=0._r8
367915974401650688do k=top_lev,pver
36802102181022619250 do i=1,ncol
36812102181021021810 dumc(i,k) = (qc(i,k)+qctend(i,k)*deltat)
3682 dumi(i,k) = (qi(i,k)+qitend(i,k)*deltat)
3683 dumfice=qsout(i,k) + qrout(i,k) + dumc(i,k) + dumi(i,k)
3684
368592085849208584 if (dumfice.gt.qsmall.and.(qsout(i,k)+dumi(i,k).gt.qsmall)) then
368659386235938623 nfice(i,k)=(qsout(i,k) + dumi(i,k))/dumfice
3687 endif
3688
3689 if (nfice(i,k).gt.1._r8) then
3690 nfice(i,k)=1._r8
3691 endif
3692
3693 enddo
3694enddo
3695
3696
3697end subroutine micro_mg_tend

370353248159744pure subroutine micro_mg_get_cols(ncol, nlev, top_lev, qcn, qin, &
370400 mgncol, mgcols)
3705
3706 ! Determines which columns microphysics should operate over by
3707 ! checking for non-zero cloud water/ice.
3708
3709 integer, intent(in) :: ncol ! Number of columns with meaningful data
3710 integer, intent(in) :: nlev ! Number of levels to use
3711 integer, intent(in) :: top_lev ! Top level for microphysics
3712
3713 real(r8), intent(in) :: qcn(:,:) ! cloud water mixing ratio (kg/kg)
3714 real(r8), intent(in) :: qin(:,:) ! cloud ice mixing ratio (kg/kg)
3715
3716 integer, intent(out) :: mgncol ! Number of columns MG will use
3717 integer, allocatable, intent(out) :: mgcols(:) ! column indices
3718
3719 integer :: lev_offset ! top_lev - 1 (defined here for consistency)
3720 logical :: ltrue(ncol) ! store tests for each column
3721
3722 integer :: i, ii ! column indices
3723
372453248106496 if (allocated(mgcols)) deallocate(mgcols)
3725
37265324853248 lev_offset = top_lev - 1
3727
3728 ! Using "any" along dimension 2 collapses across levels, but
3729 ! not columns, so we know if water is present at any level
3730 ! in each column.
3731
37322156856071361888 ltrue = any(qcn(:ncol,top_lev:(nlev+lev_offset)) >= qsmall, 2)
37332156856071361888 ltrue = ltrue .or. any(qin(:ncol,top_lev:(nlev+lev_offset)) >= qsmall, 2)
3734
3735 ! Scan for true values to get a usable list of indices.
3736
37377189522298375 mgncol = count(ltrue)
373853248266240 allocate(mgcols(mgncol))
37395324853248 i = 0
3740718952718952 do ii = 1,ncol
3741718952718952 if (ltrue(ii)) then
3742700727700727 i = i + 1
3743 mgcols(i) = ii
3744 end if
3745 end do
3746
3747end subroutine micro_mg_get_cols
